title: Oven-Fried Northern Thai Mozzarella Bowl
description: A crispy, cheese‑filled bowl that balances sweet, salty, and citrusy flavors for a soothing hangover cure.
instructions: Cook the rice noodles according to package directions, then rinse with cold water and drain.
Pat the mozzarella balls dry with paper towels.
Spread the mozzarella balls on a parchment‑lined baking sheet and drizzle with 1 tbsp olive oil.
Roast in the oven for 10 minutes or until golden and slightly burst.
Meanwhile, combine fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, chili flakes, and minced garlic in a small bowl and whisk until sugar dissolves.
Heat a skillet over medium heat, add the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil, and toss in the roasted mozzarella for 2 minutes, letting the sauce coat the cheese.
Drain the noodles and place them in a large bowl, then top with the crispy mozzarella and sauce.
Sprinkle chopped cilantro and Thai basil over the bowl, and finish with lime wedges on the side.
